 It's that time of year — the NBA is back. Even if you're a basketball fanatic, you might need a little help figuring out where to watch each game.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement With several blockbuster trades in the offseason, there's plenty to look forward to in the 2026-27 campaign. LeBron James and Jaylen Brown are now in Philly, while Giannis made the move to South Beach. Meanwhile, LaMelo Ball is now teamed up with Anthony Edwards in Minnesota, and the two are looking to be a dangerous duo.
 And of course, the media landscape is only growing larger with every season. ABC, ESPN and NBC will carry the majority of broadcast duties once again, with select games on NBA TV. Peacock and Amazon Prime Video will also continue as primary streaming partners after a successful debut last year.
 Here's everything you need to know about watching the NBA this season, including the best streaming options for each game throughout 2026-27.
 NBA live streams 2026-27
 TV channels: ABC, ESPN, NBC
 Live streams: DIRECTV , Fubo , Peacock , ESPN app 
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement NBA games will air on national TV channels like ABC, ESPN and NBC during the 2026-27 season. Cord-cutters can catch those broadcasts as well as select streaming exclusives on DIRECTV and Fubo which both offer free trials, or Peacock and the ESPN app .
 Fubo offers a free trial for new subscribers, so you can try the service before you buy. Stream ESPN, ABC, CBS, Fox, NBC and 100+ top channels of live TV and sports without cable. (Participating plans only. Taxes and fees may apply.)

 Key dates for 2026-27 NBA season
 Each team will play an 82-game schedule. The regular season will run from Oct. 20 through April 11. The NBA Playoffs will begin on April 17.
 Here's a breakdown of the 2025-26 NBA calendar:
 Regular season: Oct. 20-April 11
 NBA Cup: Oct. 30-Dec. 11
 Rivals Week: Jan. 26-30
 Trade deadline: Feb. 11
 All-Star 2026: Feb. 19-21
 Play-In Tournament: April 13-16
 NBA Playoffs: April 17
